speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is done. Two Gents is done. I am not counting a share onto this leaf, and I am not opening a coffer. The hired men stand at their ten shillings. That wage is not being laid out of anyone's purse in this parlour.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then tell me the week, if you will not tell me the money. I can spend a week. I cannot spend a silence. And do not tell me Margery's thirty-three shillings is the house. I was in the house. I know a stair when I hear one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-three was her stair on Thursday. It is not yours and it is not his. Seven shillings was a license, counted at the priory, company coin. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day. None of those three is a share, and I am not inventing a fourth number to keep you cheerful.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give him the book, John, before he names a fifth. Thou hast played today, Will. Thou needst not play the clerk as well.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday, Titus, at two. I am not in it. Tuesday, the Shrew, at two. I am in it. Tuesday morning the book is read at Dick's. Abel reads. No roll is in a hand today, and no roll leaves this parlour in a sleeve.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Tuesday is a long time to wait for a clown's roll, if the clown is me. You might say whether I am in the new one at all.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are in the company. You are not holding a part tonight. Abel has the book. Abel has not copied you a roll. I am not copying one at this table to buy peace.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Wednesday, the old Hamlet, at two. Will is in it. Thursday, rehearsal at nine, and Errors at two. Will is in it. Friday, the Shrew, at two. Not him. Saturday, Errors, at two. Him. That is the week. The Rose is not this leaf.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the reading is Tuesday, at my father's, not a rehearsal stolen from Monday. Thou wilt not bring me a part tomorrow at supper and call it manners.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. Supper tomorrow is supper. Greenwich is tomorrow, and we are not sent for. I am not carrying a comedy into Holywell in my coat.

speaker: will_kemp
text: By my hose, a man might have hoped for a line to con on a Sunday. You are a hard landlord of a book, Master Shakespeare. I shall survive until Tuesday. I have survived worse landlords.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You will survive because there is nothing to con. I am not having a part out before Abel has made it. Dick, your father has the supper. We have the week. I have no sum to read you, and I will not pretend I forgot one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done. The letter at home is still unsent. A week set down is not an answer to a wife. I am not writing one in this parlour to match the neatness of John's leaf.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go home, then. Thou hast done the play and the week. Leave the rolls where they are, which is nowhere.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nowhere is a fine place for a roll I have not been given. Tuesday, Dick's, Abel reads. I have that. I will not invent a speech on the stair to comfort myself.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Grecian Comedy was the Rose. We did not go. I am not giving their title a line on our leaf. One bill is enough for a Saturday, and it is ours, and it is already played.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Played, and done. I am not in Monday's Titus. I am in Tuesday's Shrew. I will not be confused about it on the stair, and I will not be given a part of the new one to con over Sunday.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt not be given one. My father expects supper, not a reading. A reading on a Sunday would be Kemp's idea of thrift, and it is a bad idea.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I can have a bad idea and survive the refusal of it. You have refused me. I am cheerful. By my hose, I am more cheerful than a man with eight shillings owing and no seam to show for it. That is Edith's trouble, and John has already said Lady Day, and I will not improve Lady Day.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You will not. Lady Day stands. The eight shillings stand. The ten shillings of the hired men stand where they always stand, which is not on this leaf as a payment. I have no coffer to open and I have no share to read. If I repeat it, it is because Saturday likes to grow a number when no one is looking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then no one looks. The week is the week I said. Supper tomorrow, and not a word of a roll at it. I have a sentence at home I am not sending. That is the rest of my day, and it is not this parlour's.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Take it home, then. Thou hast been plain enough for two plays. The old Hamlet on Wednesday will not need this much talking, and Errors on Thursday will need even less.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Wednesday I shall laugh at the old play, if I am near it. Thursday I shall be wherever a clown is useful. Friday the Shrew is not you, he says. I will try to remember that a Shrew can happen without the poet in it. I have seen stranger bills.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You have the week. Go and spend none of it in advance. Abel has the book. The door is that way. I am shutting the leaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it. I have Two Gents in my legs and a week in my head, and I am not adding a sum to either. Good night to the parlour.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good night to a poet who will not give me a roll. Tuesday, then. I shall be early, and I shall be loud about being early, and you will bear it.
